verdicts.reason: A shrinks the product can to a tiny speck and leaves it detached from the circle. The quote drops to tiny body-size text, and is now smaller than the attribution, which inverts the hierarchy. Big empty bands fill the canvas, so the result is unusable. B keeps the quote as the clear headline and the can at a sensible size. Its flaws: the can floats above the circle instead of sitting inside it, the attribution is jammed tight under the quote, and the lower third is empty.
